_source: PR #384 of this repository, 2026-11-09/10, recorded with the GraphQL comment edit history (userContentEdits; docs/improvement-feed/2026-11-09-read-mergify-history-from-comment-edits.md) and timelineItems. Synthetic-ized: logins renamed, links replaced, <details> lists dropped, pr-doctor file list replaced. heads[].at is the commit date (GitHub has no push date); conflict and heads[].greenAt are synthetic, read from Mergify: main conflicted from the dequeue until the fix push, and each head went green when Mergify stopped waiting on Build and check (the second head was replaced before CI finished). Record a new timeline the same way: gh api graphql with comments{userContentEdits{editedAt diff}} and timelineItems.
